thread:
neha: Noticed a sudden jump in degen-routed fncall traffic for a new canary slice in ap-northeast. Cost graph flat but variant token_count shows a shadow bump. Anyone seen validator rejects correlate?

tom: Paste of a log from api-12: `WARN validate_fncall req=rd-55 reason=type_mismatch field=tool.args.amount route=primary -> degen_variant`

oliver: type_mismatch usually means model returned numeric as string or null where number expected. Default behavior routes to degen_variant (fallback) and we still bill tokens to that variant. UX doesn't show "validation routed" so product sees spend but not cause.

agent-bot: alert: schema-validator: reason=type_mismatch count=63 route=degen_variant sample=0.05

neha: Proposal: emit a small set of new labels on fncall metrics: validation_outcome={accepted,soft_reject,routed,hard_reject} and validation_reason={missing_field,type_mismatch,extra_props,parse_error}. Add route_slice label too. Example: fncall_requests_total{route="degen_variant",validation_reason="type_mismatch",validation_outcome="routed",slice="canary-7"}++

tom: Agree but watch cardinality. Keep validation_reason and slice enums bounded. Also add trace tags validation.reason and fallback_variant so traces show which variant served tokens.

oliver: For console: add a compact probe on model-variant pages called "Validation routing" with sparkline + top reasons. Clicking a reason calls samples API (redacted) to inspect examples.

neha: Samples API spec: GET /samples?reason=type_mismatch&route=degen_variant&limit=25 returns redacted json blobs. Redact keys named email, token, ssn, phone and truncate long strings >500 chars. Default sample_rate=0.05 for noise reasons; sample_rate=1.0 for parse_error.

tom: Billing: add event field validation_status=routed in the event stream so billing pipeline can tag or hold. Don't change billing semantics yet; tag-only for now.

oliver: Alerting rule suggestion: if sum(rate(fncall_requests_total{validation_outcome="routed"}[5m])) by (route) > 0.01 * sum(rate(fncall_requests_total[5m])) by (route) AND sum(rate(model_token_count[5m])) by (route) > 1.1 * baseline -> page oncall. Clear message: "validation routed >1% and token spike".

neha: Also we need per-canary dashboards; when toggling strict-validate per-slice, owners must see validation metrics scoped to the slice.

tom: I'll draft a short RFC with metric names, label enums, sample API, and rollout plan (staging -> canary slices -> global). Will include prom examples and cardinality limits.

oliver: Add a short playbook: if alerts fire, check samples API, if majority are type_mismatch from model drift, rollback strict-validate for that slice and open an eval with research.

neha: One privacy note: samples API must redact any value that looks like a token (regex), and obfuscate numbers that look like ids unless request owner approves.

tagent-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for feature/validator-tags by tom.

tom: RFC stub: https://console.redwood.ai/rfcs/validator-routing-probe-v2 (WIP). I will attach a 30m trace from staging after deploy.

neha: Great. I'll reserve the canary window tomorrow 08:00 JST to validate. Thanks all :thumbsup:
